config.name: Support and Critical Dashboards
config.content:
Dashboard Support & Critical Navigation
 Need help using these dashboards?   Join Office Hours for LogicMonitor help, every Tuesday at 2:05 PM. 
Office Hours • Every Tuesday • 2:05 PM
Details in  #monitoring-services 

How to use this section: Start with Service Health, then review Connectivity & Network, and finally Cloud & Capacity.
Critical Dashboards (ordered by operational importance)
TIER 1 • Service Impact
 Critical Service Health 
Overall service impact and status.
 EIP Infrastructure and Service Health and Performance 
Core platform health and performance.
 Leadership Navigation Dashboard 
Executive overview and navigation.
TIER 2 • Security & Resilience
 DDoS Detection 
Threat detection and disruption signals.
 SCMR Datacenter UPS & Environmental Status 
Power and environmental risk indicators.
TIER 2 • Connectivity & Network
 Azure Express Route Circuits 
Cloud-to-campus connectivity health.
 Harvard Site-to-Site Data Center Connectivity 
Datacenter interconnect monitoring.
 DNS Resolution Health Dashboard 
Foundational DNS service health.
TIER 3 • Cloud & Campus Visibility
 Utilization of Internet2 (i2) and AWS Transit Gateways 
Backbone and transit utilization.
 AWS Resource Counts and Usage 
AWS inventory and usage trends.
Tip: Start with Critical Service Health if you are unsure where to begin.
